objective: OBJ-007 item A3 - negative-validation scenario matrix

catalogue_reconciliation.reconciliation_arithmetic: 1322 route constants in APIConfig.java - 13 surplus constants (11 paths are declared by more than one constant name) = 1309 distinct paths. 3 of those are not catalogue endpoints (//api/AzureKeyVault/GetDatabaseStatus; /api/Lob/Get/{id}; /api/User), leaving 1306. NOTE: 1322 is the stale figure that circulates for this catalogue - it is the raw constant count, not the endpoint count.

selection_rule: Every applicable scenario was generated (17110 in total). Each endpoint then keeps at most 8: the four universal core categories (invalid authentication, wrong HTTP method, invalid authorization, SQL-injection string), the single highest-value shape-driven scenario, then the remaining slots filled preferring globally under-represented categories so that no rare-but-real scenario is truncated out of the matrix entirely.

existing_negative_coverage.note: LIVE means a @DataProvider exists that TestNG can resolve at runtime. Everything else is data or code that cannot execute.

orphaned_workbook.why_dead: AutoConfigs.java:37 declares Negative_API_ExcelDataProviderFileName and 6 environment files set it, but no @DataProvider in API_DataProviderUtils.java ever reads it. Every provider reads API_ExcelDataProviderFileName instead.

adminapi_settings_track.note: The only envelope-aware negative testing in the framework - and none of its endpoints are in the 1,306 /api/ catalogue.

run_evidence.reconciliation: 875 catalogue endpoints appear in the run's hop list. 5 of them carry no 'status' key at all - the request was never issued because the runner skipped it as destructive (results.json meta.skipped: DeleteAdDomain x2, RemoveUserStatusDetails x2, DeleteRTSMLog x1). 875 - 5 = 870 endpoints were actually exercised, matching the prior figure of 870 exactly. Of those, 4 returned no response at all (status null) and 866 returned a numeric HTTP status.
